# BillingBee

> BillingBee is an AI-powered invoicing SaaS for freelancers and small businesses worldwide, with full support for Indian workflows (GST, Razorpay, UPI).

## Product

BillingBee lets you create, send, and manage invoices using natural language commands. No forms, no friction — just describe what you need and the AI handles the rest. Invoice ready in 30 seconds.

## Key Features

- Natural language invoice creation
- Multi-currency support (30+ currencies)
- Payment integrations: Stripe, Razorpay, PayPal, UPI
- Client portal for online payments (no sign-up needed for clients)
- Automated payment reminders
- Revenue and earnings analytics
- PDF invoice generation
- GST-compliant invoices for Indian businesses

## Pricing

- Free: Basic invoicing, up to 5 invoices/month, 3 clients — free forever
- Pro: $9.99/month — unlimited invoices, AI collections, payment links (Stripe, Razorpay, PayPal)

## Natural Language Commands

- "Create invoice for Acme Corp for ₹50,000 for web design"
- "Invoice TechCorp $5,000 for website development, due in 15 days"
- "Show unpaid invoices"
- "How much did I earn this month?"
- "Send reminder to clients with overdue invoices"
- "Mark invoice #42 as paid"
